title: Complex eigenvalues
source_notes: Exercise24: the real part of a complex eigenvector may be zero; the printed assertion requires a nonzero qualification. The solution proves real eigenvalues and the existence of a nonzero real or imaginary eigenvector without invoking the later spectral theorem.
verification: Exact SymPy characteristic polynomials, eigenspace nullspaces, AP=PD/AP=PC and basis coordinate products verified; standalone PDF compiles without layout/reference warnings.
